name: lw_43263
statement: (n : ℕ) (hn : n > 0) : (4^n / (2 * Real.sqrt n)) < (2 * n).choose n ∧ ((2 * n).choose n) < (4^n / Real.sqrt (2 * n))
closed: ∀ (n : ℕ) (hn : n > 0), (4^n / (2 * Real.sqrt n)) < (2 * n).choose n ∧ ((2 * n).choose n) < (4^n / Real.sqrt (2 * n))
informal: Prove that $\frac{4^n}{2\sqrt{n}}<\binom{2n}{n}<\frac{4^n}{\sqrt{2n}}$ for all natural numbers n
